description: On the countertop in front of you there’s a shallow cardboard tray holding small items like keys, a cloth, cables, and a smartphone, and to the right there’s a small clear plastic drawer unit with white drawers. The left hand stays resting near the tray while the right hand reaches into the tray, grips the phone as a right-hand object, lifts it up and to the right, then slides it into the lower clear compartment of the drawer unit and releases it.
